preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(A) > 0 and len(B) > 0 and all(any(u in A or v in A for u, v in edges) and any(u in B or v in B for u, v in edges) for u, v in edges))
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to split the graph, output '-1'. Otherwise, both A and B must be valid vertex covers.
The total number of vertices in A and B must not exceed the total number of vertices n.
Both A and B must contain at least one vertex.
